        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCocoIndex Knowledge Graph Flows for UAP Research\nComprehensive ETL processing using existing entity schema\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport dataclasses\nimport logging\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Union\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom enum import Enum\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\ntry:\n    import cocoindex\n    COCOINDEX_AVAILABLE = True\n    logger.info(\"CocoIndex available for knowledge graph processing\")\nexcept ImportError:\n    COCOINDEX_AVAILABLE = False\n    logger.warning(\"CocoIndex not available - install with: pip install cocoindex\")\n\n# Database connections\nif COCOINDEX_AVAILABLE:\n    postgres_conn_spec = cocoindex.add_auth_entry(\n        \"PostgreSQLConnection\",\n        cocoindex.targets.PostgreSQLConnection(\n            host=os.getenv(\"DB_HOST\", \"localhost\"),\n            port=int(os.getenv(\"DB_PORT\", \"5432\")),\n            database=os.getenv(\"DB_NAME\", \"disclosure_rag\"),\n            user=os.getenv(\"DB_USER\"),\n            password=os.getenv(\"DB_PASSWORD\")\n        )\n    )\n\n    neo4j_conn_spec = cocoindex.add_auth_entry(\n        \"Neo4jConnection\", \n        cocoindex.targets.Neo4jConnection(\n            uri=os.getenv(\"NEO4J_URI\", \"bolt://localhost:7687\"),\n            user=os.getenv(\"NEO4J_USER\", \"neo4j\"),\n            password=os.getenv(\"NEO4J_PASSWORD\", \"disclosure_kg\")\n        )\n    )\n\n# Enums for consistency with existing schema\nclass EntityType(Enum):\n    PERSON = \"person\"\n    EVENT = \"event\" \n    ORGANIZATION = \"organization\"\n    LOCATION = \"location\"\n    ARTIFACT = \"artifact\"\n    SIGHTING = \"sighting\"\n    TESTIMONY = \"testimony\"\n    DOCUMENT = \"document\"\n    TOPIC = \"topic\"",

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nImport core UFO/UAP tables to PostgreSQL wire-enabled database\nFocus: key-figures, artifacts, events, topics, testimonies, organizations\n\"\"\"\n\nimport asyncio\nimport asyncpg\nimport csv\nimport ssl\nimport json\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nclass CoreTableImporter:\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.postgres_url = \"postgresql://kgubvq:xau_T2uckroqht3tNd7pL3uETsxM0EC5WSNd1@us-east-1.sql.xata.sh/ultraterrestrial-postgres:main?sslmode=require\"\n        self.exports_path = Path(\"/Users/liamellis/Desktop/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/apps/app/scripts/xata-exports/exports\")\n        \n        # Core tables to import (order matters for dependencies)\n        self.core_tables = [\n            'organizations',    # Independent - import first\n            'key-figures',     # May reference organizations\n            'topics',          # Independent\n            'events',          # Independent\n            'testimonies',     # May reference events/people\n            'artifacts'        # May reference events/locations\n        ]\n        \n        # Table name mappings\n        self.table_mappings = {\n            'key-figures': 'key_figures'\n        }\n        \n        print(f\"🛸 Core Tables Import\")\n        print(f\"📅 {datetime.now().isoformat()}\")\n        print(f\"🎯 Focus: {', '.join(self.core_tables)}\")\n        print()\n\n    async def connect(self):\n        \"\"\"Connect with optimized settings\"\"\"\n        ssl_context = ssl.create_default_context()\n        ssl_context.check_hostname = False\n        ssl_context.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE\n        \n        self.conn = await asyncpg.connect(\n            self.postgres_url, \n            ssl=ssl_context, \n            command_timeout=120,\n            server_settings={'statement_timeout': '120000'}\n        )\n        print(\"✅ Connected to PostgreSQL\")\n\n    async def close(self):\n        if hasattr(self, 'conn'):\n            await self.conn.close()",

        ],
        "originalContents": "## 🔧 Agent System Commands\n\n### Individual Agents\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Entity extraction agent\npython agents/entity_extraction_agent.py\n\n# Content analysis agent\npython agents/content_analysis_agent.py\n\n# Claims and evidence agent\npython agents/claims_evidence_agent.py\n\n# Historical timeline agent\npython agents/historical_timeline_agent.py\n\n# Geographic agent\npython agents/geospatial_agent.py\n\n# Network analysis agent\npython agents/network_agent.py\n\n# Theory development agent\npython agents/theory_agent.py\n\n# Documentation agent\npython agents/documentation_agent.py\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Research Crew (Multi-Agent)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Research crew orchestration\npython agents/research_crew.py\n\n# Note: This is currently in development\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 💾 Data Management Commands\n\n### Knowledge Base Operations\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Export documents\npython -c \"from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD; kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD(); kb.export_document('DOC_ID', '/export/path')\"\n\n# Bulk import\npython -c \"from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD; kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD(); kb.bulk_import('/import/path', 'article')\"\n\n# List documents\npython -c \"from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD; kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD(); print(kb.list_documents())\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Database Synchronization\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Upstash sync (manual)\npython lib/sync_to_upstash_search_integrated.py\n\n# Note: Automated sync plans documented but not yet implemented\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🎨 Visualization Commands\n\n### Terminal Visualizations\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# All processing commands show enhanced terminal display automatically\npython main.py \"URL\"  # Shows UFO-themed processing animation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Web Visualizations\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Launch dashboard for all visualization features\n./launch_dashboard.sh\n\n# Available visualizations:\n# - Real-time entity extraction\n# - Geographic UFO analysis\n# - Content analytics\n# - Interactive charts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 Debug \u0026 Development Commands\n\n### Logging \u0026 Debug\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Enable debug logging\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Disclosure RAG - Command Cheatsheet\n\n**Quick Reference Guide - Updated June 25, 2025**\n\n## 🚀 Quick Start Commands\n\n### Launch Main Interfaces\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Web Dashboard (Recommended - Full Featured)\n./launch_dashboard.sh\n# Access: http://localhost:8501\n\n# Enhanced CLI Interface\npython cli.py\n\n# Knowledge Base UI\npython knowledge_base_ui.py\n\n# Basic Chat Interface\npython disclosure_chat.py\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📥 Content Processing Commands\n\n### Process URLs (YouTube/Web)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Main processing script (enhanced)\npython main.py \"https://youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID\"\npython main.py \"https://example.com/article\" --upload\npython main.py \"https://example.com/article\" --no-kb\n\n# Shell script wrapper\n./main.sh process-url \"https://example.com/article\"\n\n# Direct YouTube processing\npython -c \"from lib.youtube import generate_transcript; generate_transcript('URL')\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Process Local Files\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Main processing\npython main.py \"/path/to/document.pdf\" --upload\npython main.py \"/path/to/file.txt\"\n\n# Shell script wrapper  \n./main.sh process-file \"/path/to/document.pdf\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Command Options\n\n- &#96;--upload&#96;: Upload to OpenAI vector store\n- &#96;--no-kb&#96;: Skip adding to local knowledge base\n- &#96;--status&#96;: Show integration status\n\n---\n\n## 🎛️ Interface Launch Commands\n\n### Web Dashboard (Streamlit)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Quick launch\n./launch_dashboard.sh\n\n# Manual launch\nstreamlit run streamlit_app.py\nstreamlit run streamlit_app.py --server.port 8502  # Custom port\n\n# Access URLs\nhttp://localhost:8501  # Default\nhttp://localhost:8502  # Custom port\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### CLI Interfaces\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Enhanced CLI (with Charm tools if available)\npython cli.py\n\n# Charm tools demo\npython charm_demo.py\n\n# Basic knowledge base CLI\npython knowledge_base_ui.py\n\n# Entity extraction CLI\npython entity_extraction_cli.py\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Chat Interfaces\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Local knowledge base chat\npython disclosure_chat.py\n\n# Note: Agno chat files referenced but may need setup\n# python agno_disclosure_chat.py\n",

        "contents": "# python agno_disclosure_chat_with_files.py\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 Search \u0026 Query Commands\n\n### Knowledge Base Search\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Shell script search\n./main.sh search \"search query\"\n\n# Direct Python search\npython -c \"from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD; kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD(); print(kb.search_documents('query'))\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Database Queries\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# PostgreSQL direct queries\npython -c \"from lib.connectors.ultraterrestrial_db import UltraterrestrialDatabase; db = UltraterrestrialDatabase(); db.connect()\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📊 Analytics \u0026 Visualization Commands\n\n### System Statistics\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Shell script stats\n./main.sh stats\n\n# Knowledge base statistics\npython -c \"from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD; kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD(); print(kb.get_statistics())\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Geographic Analysis\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Launch dashboard for geographic features\n./launch_dashboard.sh\n# Navigate to: Geographic Analysis tab\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Extraction Analysis\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Process with real-time visualization (via dashboard)\n./launch_dashboard.sh\n# Upload files in: Entity Extraction tab\n\n# CLI entity extraction\npython agents/entity_extraction_agent.py\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ Setup \u0026 Configuration Commands\n\n### Initial Setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Complete setup script\n./setup.sh\n\n# Manual dependency installation\npip install -r requirements.txt\n\n# Environment configuration\ncp .env.template .env\n# Edit .env with your API keys\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Database Setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# PostgreSQL setup (if needed)\n# Follow instructions in setup.sh\n\n# Test database connections\npython -c \"from lib.connectors.ultraterrestrial_db import UltraterrestrialDatabase; db = UltraterrestrialDatabase(); print('Connection:', db.test_connection())\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Dependency Management\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install optional Charm CLI tools (for enhanced experience)\nbrew install gum huh glow glamour  # macOS\n# or follow Go installation instructions\n\n# Update Python dependencies\npip install -r requirements.txt --upgrade\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n",

        "originalContents": "# python agno_disclosure_chat_with_files.py\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 Search \u0026 Query Commands\n\n### Knowledge Base Search\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Shell script search\n./main.sh search \"search query\"\n\n# Direct Python search\npython -c \"from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD; kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD(); print(kb.search_documents('query'))\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Database Queries\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# PostgreSQL direct queries\npython -c \"from lib.connectors.ultraterrestrial_db import UltraterrestrialDatabase; db = UltraterrestrialDatabase(); db.connect()\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📊 Analytics \u0026 Visualization Commands\n\n### System Statistics\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Shell script stats\n./main.sh stats\n\n# Knowledge base statistics\npython -c \"from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD; kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD(); print(kb.get_statistics())\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Geographic Analysis\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Launch dashboard for geographic features\n./launch_dashboard.sh\n# Navigate to: Geographic Analysis tab\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Extraction Analysis\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Process with real-time visualization (via dashboard)\n./launch_dashboard.sh\n# Upload files in: Entity Extraction tab\n\n# CLI entity extraction\npython agents/entity_extraction_agent.py\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ Setup \u0026 Configuration Commands\n\n### Initial Setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Complete setup script\n./setup.sh\n\n# Manual dependency installation\npip install -r requirements.txt\n\n# Environment configuration\ncp .env.template .env\n# Edit .env with your API keys\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Database Setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# PostgreSQL setup (if needed)\n# Follow instructions in setup.sh\n\n# Test database connections\npython -c \"from lib.connectors.ultraterrestrial_db import UltraterrestrialDatabase; db = UltraterrestrialDatabase(); print('Connection:', db.test_connection())\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Dependency Management\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install optional Charm CLI tools (for enhanced experience)\nbrew install gum huh glow glamour  # macOS\n# or follow Go installation instructions\n\n# Update Python dependencies\npip install -r requirements.txt --upgrade\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n",

        "contents": "import logging\nimport os\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Optional\n\n# Import the Xata client from the xata SDK.\n# Depending on your SDK version, you might do:\nfrom xata.client import XataClient\n\n# Initialize logging (optional)\nlogging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n# Setup: Retrieve Xata credentials from environment variables.\nXATA_API_KEY = os.environ.get(\"XATA_API_KEY\")\nXATA_DATABASE_URL = os.environ.get(\"XATA_DATABASE_URL\")\nXATA_BRANCH = os.environ.get(\"XATA_BRANCH\", \"main\")\n\nif not XATA_API_KEY or not XATA_DATABASE_URL:\n    logger.error(\n        \"Missing XATA_API_KEY or XATA_DATABASE_URL environment variable.\")\n    raise EnvironmentError(\"XATA API credentials must be set.\")\n\n# Extract database and branch info from URL\n# URL format: https://workspace-id.region.xata.sh/db/database_name\ntry:\n    from urllib.parse import urlparse\n    parsed_url = urlparse(XATA_DATABASE_URL)\n    path_parts = parsed_url.path.strip('/').split('/')\n    if len(path_parts) \u003e= 2 and path_parts[0] == 'db':\n        DATABASE_NAME = path_parts[1]\n    else:\n        DATABASE_NAME = \"ultraterrestrial\"  # fallback\n    DB_BRANCH_NAME = f\"{DATABASE_NAME}:{XATA_BRANCH}\"\nexcept Exception as e:\n    logger.warning(f\"Could not parse database URL: {e}\")\n    DATABASE_NAME = \"ultraterrestrial\"\n    DB_BRANCH_NAME = f\"{DATABASE_NAME}:{XATA_BRANCH}\"\n\n# Initialize the Xata client\ntry:\n    xata_client = XataClient(api_key=XATA_API_KEY)\n    logger.info(f\"Xata client initialized for database: {DB_BRANCH_NAME}\")\nexcept Exception as e:\n    logger.error(f\"Failed to initialize Xata client: {e}\")\n    raise EnvironmentError(\"Could not initialize Xata client\")",

        "contents": "research_prompt = \"\"\"\n# SYSTEM_PROMPT\n\n**You are an AI research assistant focused on gathering, organizing, analyzing and documenting the resources you are presented with to assist in evaluating their introduction into the platform knowledge layer\n\nYou will help users and other researchers investigate, understand, and analyze the UFO phenomeon by organizing and documenting all the information presented to you according to the following structured research methodology.\n\nYour responses should always be organized as precisely as possible according the this strict architecture and be ready for processing and insertion into the platform database.**\n\n## Core Knowledge Structure: Main Entities You Track\n\nFor Topics, you should:\n\n- Capture essential identifiers (name, unique title)\n- Write clear, evidence-based summaries\n- Note if visual evidence exists (photo/photos)\n- Always link to relevant SMEs, testimonies, and events\n\nFor Personnel, document:\n\n- Professional details (name [unique], bio, role)\n\n- Authority metrics:\n  - Rank (1-100)\n  - Credibility (1-100)\n  - Scientific/academic authority (1-100)\n  - Public recognition (1-100)\n- Track their roles as: organization members, SMEs, witnesses, authors\n\nFor Events, include:\n\n- Core details (name, unique title, description)\n- Precise location (coordinates + named location)\n- Exact timing (datetime)\n- Visual documentation\n- Structured metadata for key attributes\n- Links to all involved SMEs and testimonies\n\nFor Organizations:\n\n- Full profiles (name, unique title, specialization)\n- Comprehensive descriptions\n- Visual identifiers (official photos/logos)\n- Member relationships\n- Document attribution\n\n## Evidence Documentation\n\nFor Testimonies, capture:\n\n- Direct claims (quoted when possible)\n- Summary analysis\n- Supporting documentation\n- Datetime of testimony\n- Witness details\n- Organizational context\n- Topic connections\n\nFor Documents:\n\n- Complete files\n- Full text content\n- Semantic vector for matching (1536d)\n- Source attribution\n- Publication datetime\n- Origin URL\n- Organization attribution\n\nFor Sightings:\n\n- Precise datetime\n- Exact location (city, state, country, coordinates)\n- Detailed description\n- Shape classification\n- Duration measurements\n- Media evidence\n- Observer comments\n- Post datetime\n\nFor Artifacts:\n\n- Unique identifier\n- Detailed description\n- Visual documentation\n- Temporal classification\n- Source verification\n- Origin tracing\n\n## Research Protocol\n\nWhen conducting research, you should ensure:\n\n1. RELATIONSHIPS\n\n- Link testimonies to relevant topics/events\n- Connect SMEs to their areas of expertise\n- Map organizational relationships\n- Track document attribution\n\nWhen responding to queries:\n\n- Structure information to match database schema\n- Include all required fields\n- Note any missing required data\n- Suggest related entries to investigate\n- Provide clear link relationships\n\n## Output Format **\n\n*NASA UFO hearing: Irish expert believes orbs are a ‘global defence network’ - SundayWorld.com Summary\n\nhttps://www.sundayworld.com/news/irish-news/irish-ufo-expert-believes-orbs-discussed-in-nasa-meeting-are-a-global-defence-network/a5835201.html\n\n**=== APPLIED RESEARCH METHODOLOGY CONTENT ANALYSIS ===**\n\nResearch Agent Analysis:\nHere is how I would structure the information provided according to the database schema:\n\nTopic: Metallic Orb UFOs\nSummary: Metallic orb-shaped UFOs have been reported being spotted all over the world, displaying unusual flight behavior like hypersonic speeds and the ability to hover motionless. They are often seen in triangular formations and seem to intercept and disable other UFOs. \nVisual Evidence: Yes (footage shown at NASA hearing, photographs)\n\nPersonnel:\n\nName: Patrick Jackson \nRole: UFO Researcher, Author\nBio: A 45-year-old Irishman and IT database specialist who has studied UFOs for over 20 years. He has written the book \"Quantum Paranormal\" detailing his theories.\nOnline Presence: N/A\nAuthority Metrics: \n  Rank: 75 (proposed innovative theory backed by some experts)\n  Credibility: 70 (claims sound unconventional but has done long-term research)\n  Scientific Authority: 60 (not an academic but has specialized knowledge)\n  Public Recognition: 40 (relative unknown outside UFO research circles)\n\nName: David Spergel\nRole: NASA UAP Chief \nBio: Leads NASA's scientific study of unidentified aerial phenomena (UAPs/UFOs)\nAuthority Metrics:\n  Rank: 95 (head of NASA's UAP research)\n  Credibility: 90 (NASA lending credibility to UFO study)\n  Scientific Authority: 100 (elite scientist and academic)\n  Public Recognition: 80 (NASA role gives high visibility)\n\nName: Sean Kirkpatrick\nRole: Pentagon Official\nAuthority Metrics:\n  Rank: 90 (high-ranking pentagon official)\n  Credibility: 85 (representing official US stance)\n  Scientific Authority: 60 (military not scientific authority)\n  Public Recognition: 70 (some public visibility)\n\nName: Joe Albregg\nRole: Retired US Air Force Pilot, UFO witness\nBio: Retired military pilot who has witnessed UFOs and supports Patrick Jackson's theories\nAuthority Metrics:\n  Rank: 80 (military veteran with UFO sighting experience) \n  Credibility: 75 (first-hand witness but could be subjective)\n  Scientific Authority: 40 (military not scientific background)\n  Public Recognition: 30 (relatively unknown)\n\nEvent: NASA Public Hearing on UFOs\nDescription: A 4-hour public hearing held by NASA on June 2023 to discuss UFO/UAP sightings, including metallic orb UFOs spotted globally displaying unusual flight capabilities.\nLocation: Washington D.C., USA (Coordinates: 38.8977°N 77.0365°W)\nDate/Time: June 2023 (Exact date not provided)\nVisual Documentation: Yes (Footage and images from hearing)\nTestimonies: \n  - Sean Kirkpatrick testifying about \"interesting maneuvers\" by orb UFOs\n  - Discussion of analysis on database of 800 UFO reports\n\nOrganization: NASA\nDescription: NASA is the civilian space agency of the United States federal government responsible for science and technology related to air and space.\nSpecialization: Space exploration, aeronautics research\nLogo/Photos: Yes (NASA insignia)\n\nTestimony:\nQuote: \"The spheres behave like a global defence network that intercept space based threats ranging from meteors to other space based threats.\" -         "contents": "# Fresh Data Export Guide\n\n## Why Re-export?\n\nThe current CSV exports have formatting issues:\n- **users.csv**: Duplicate headers/rows (corrupted export)\n- **events.csv**: Multi-line descriptions breaking CSV parsing\n- **Inconsistent quoting**: Some files have malformed quote handling\n\n## Option 1: Fresh Xata Export (Recommended)\n\n### Via Xata CLI:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install Xata CLI if not already installed\nnpm install -g @xata.io/cli\n\n# Login to Xata\nxata auth login\n\n# Export all tables with proper CSV formatting\nxata table export users --output users.csv --format csv\nxata table export organizations --output organizations.csv --format csv\nxata table export personnel --output personnel.csv --format csv\nxata table export events --output events.csv --format csv\nxata table export topics --output topics.csv --format csv\nxata table export testimonies --output testimonies.csv --format csv\nxata table export documents --output documents.csv --format csv\nxata table export sightings --output sightings.csv --format csv\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Via Xata Web UI:\n1. Go to https://app.xata.io\n2. Navigate to your database\n3. For each table: \n   - Click \"Export\"\n   - Choose \"CSV\" format\n   - Download clean export\n\n## Option 2: Use Existing Data with Fixes\n\nIf the current exports represent the actual data state and you want to keep them:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Run the CSV fixer script\nnode fix-and-seed.ts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis will:\n- Clean duplicate headers\n- Handle multi-line values\n- Parse malformed quotes\n- Import clean records\n\n## Option 3: Check Source Database\n\nThe CSV exports might be from an **old/different Xata instance**.         "originalContents": "# Fresh Data Export Guide\n\n## Why Re-export?\n\nThe current CSV exports have formatting issues:\n- **users.csv**: Duplicate headers/rows (corrupted export)\n- **events.csv**: Multi-line descriptions breaking CSV parsing\n- **Inconsistent quoting**: Some files have malformed quote handling\n\n## Option 1: Fresh Xata Export (Recommended)\n\n### Via Xata CLI:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install Xata CLI if not already installed\nnpm install -g @xata.io/cli\n\n# Login to Xata\nxata auth login\n\n# Export all tables with proper CSV formatting\nxata table export users --output users.csv --format csv\nxata table export organizations --output organizations.csv --format csv\nxata table export personnel --output personnel.csv --format csv\nxata table export events --output events.csv --format csv\nxata table export topics --output topics.csv --format csv\nxata table export testimonies --output testimonies.csv --format csv\nxata table export documents --output documents.csv --format csv\nxata table export sightings --output sightings.csv --format csv\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Via Xata Web UI:\n1. Go to https://app.xata.io\n2. Navigate to your database\n3. For each table: \n   - Click \"Export\"\n   - Choose \"CSV\" format\n   - Download clean export\n\n## Option 2: Use Existing Data with Fixes\n\nIf the current exports represent the actual data state and you want to keep them:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Run the CSV fixer script\nnode fix-and-seed.ts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis will:\n- Clean duplicate headers\n- Handle multi-line values\n- Parse malformed quotes\n- Import clean records\n\n## Option 3: Check Source Database\n\nThe CSV exports might be from an **old/different Xata instance**.
